purpose: A senior professional with a solid income, a monthly investment plan and goals, who has not yet told the application their monthly essential spending or easy-access savings. The risk and goal steps run, but the compliance step cannot confirm the emergency-fund rule, and that existing rule is binding and fails closed: the real compliance engine returns REJECT, so no recommendation or explanation is produced. No rule was added or changed -- an unknown emergency-fund position is never treated as sufficient. Spouse member of the family household.
